data.name: iQFace
data.subtitle: Facebook tweak build by 7MD
data.localizedDescription: iQFace is a tweaked Facebook build with the iQFace tweak by 7MD, one of the Facebook modifications distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault source. Feature set is defined by the iQFace tweak.

compatibility.notes: Tweak by 7MD; distributed ready-to-sideload via the IPA Vault source. Facebook 577.x builds require iOS 15.1 or newer. Uses its own bundle identifier, so it installs alongside the stock App Store Facebook.
